user.title: Kasa Doorbell (local)
user.description: Everything runs locally on your network — the TP-Link cloud is never contacted. Your account email and password are used only to authenticate directly with the camera, which then tells us its model and device ID.

data.stream_password: Local secret (optional — leave blank to derive it from your password)

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the camera. Check the IP address, and that Home Assistant is on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected those credentials. Check your TP-Link account email and password.

init.title: Kasa Doorbell options
init.description: Everything runs locally on your network. Motion poll interval: how often to read the camera's motion state (lower = faster response). Motion safety clear: if readings stop arriving mid-detection, clear motion after this many seconds.
